text: Sell RGTI — down 25%, it's the weakest of your three quantum computing bets, a tiny company burning cash in a speculative space with no clear path to profitability, and the REDUCE signal confirms the thesis is failing.

Sell KTOS — down 28% with a REDUCE signal, and despite an exciting drone story, Kratos has a pattern of overpromising on revenue that hasn't translated into results worth holding through this kind of drawdown.
Sell 5UR.DE — down 16% on a small niche position with a REDUCE signal, the loss is outsized relative to the position size and there's no compelling reason to keep capital tied up here.
Trim IONQ — up 17% but this is a cash-burning, pre-revenue quantum computing company riding pure speculation, so lock in some of that gain before the narrative fades.
Trim PLTR — up 7% but trading at 100x+ revenue multiples means even great execution is already priced in many times over, so reduce your exposure to protect gains.
Trim QBTS — down 6.6% with limited revenue and no clear profitability path, and with RGTI already flagged for sale you should also lighten this second weak quantum position.
Trim ONDS — down nearly 15% as a small speculative defence-tech name with limited revenue, the risk of further deterioration is high and the position isn't earning its place in your portfolio.
Trim EL — down 17% with weakening demand in China and travel retail, two of its most important growth drivers, suggesting the turnaround story needs more time than your capital should wait for.
